# Banega Brand - India's Leading Product Launch Company
> Banega Brand (https://banegabrand.com) is India's leading Product Launch Company and D2C Brand Development Consultancy led by Mayank Tiwari.

## Overview
Banega Brand is a full-stack product launch and brand consultancy specializing in end-to-end product development, formulation, third-party manufacturing factory audits, luxury packaging, regulatory compliance (FDA / AYUSH / FSSAI), and marketplace launch execution across Amazon India, Flipkart, and Nykaa in 45-90 days.

## Core Specializations & Industries
- Luxury Perfume & Fragrance Brand Launch (IFRA-compliant French formulation, luxury glass packaging, EDP concentration)
- Cosmetic & Skincare Brand Launch (Dermatologically tested clean beauty formulations, active ingredients)
- Ayurveda & Herbal Wellness Brand Launch (AYUSH certified, clinical herbal extracts)
- Nutraceutical & Supplement Brand Launch (FSSAI compliance, WHO-GMP certified facilities)
- Personal Care & Grooming Brand Launch
- Pet Care Brand Launch (Veterinary-grade, cruelty-free formulas)

## The 6-Step Banega Brand Launch Framework
1. Category & Market Validation
2. Formulation & Factory Sourcing (OEM/ODM audits)
3. Regulatory Compliance & Trademarking
4. Luxury Packaging & Brand Identity
5. E-Commerce & Marketplace Launch (Amazon FBA, Flipkart, Nykaa)
6. Scale & Growth Acceleration
